title: Policy Decision System (PDS) - A Fish-Control Paradigm for Intelligent Systems
description: This repository introduces the Policy Decision System (PDS), a control-centric paradigm for intelligent systems. PDS reformulates intelligence from output prediction to policy-governed decision over future space. Its core structure is a Five-Pillar Fish-Control Architecture composed of: (I) Knowledge Model, (II) State / Trajectory, (III) Future Candidate Space, (IV) Decision Engine, and (V) Policy System. Within this formulation, intelligence is not treated as a one-shot mapping from input to output, but as controlled selection among multiple possible futures under explicit goals, constraints, risks, and strategies. PDS is positioned as one of the three foundational axes of Structural Intelligence: CCC for structure, Trajectory Intelligence for dynamics, and PDS for control. The repository includes theoretical framing, canonical diagrams, policy decomposition, dynamic PDS with evolution loops, multi-agent extensions, minimal runtime architecture, industrial use cases, formal mathematical expression, and benchmark design. PDS is intended as a unifying framework that can reinterpret and coordinate language models, reinforcement learning systems, optimization systems, and broader decision architectures within a common policy-aware structure.
